display_name: Declared IaC, Kubernetes And Dockerfile Configuration Evidence
validation_rules: outputs/iac-config-evidence.json must satisfy iac-config-evidence.schema.json and outputs/base-image-inventory.json must satisfy iac-config-base-image-inventory.schema.json; cross-record rules are secrets_iac_contracts.validate_iac_attempt

declared exposure only: a declared-exposure-lead carries exposure DECLARED_EXPOSURE and a network-exposure or public-access-grant category; OBSERVED_EXPOSURE is schema-valid only so that it is rejected by name; nothing here observes cloud, cluster, registry or runtime state
exposure is non-null exactly when the assertion is declared-exposure-lead
no tool message, title, remediation text, snippet or resource attribute value is published: a hit is a rule id, its rule-pack identity, a closed category, a resource address and a location
every hit's rule_pack (kind, identity_id, sha256) must equal a rule-pack or policy-bundle data identity of its tool instance in tool-results.json

every hit's and base image's tool_id must resolve to a tool instance with a validated output in tool-results.json, its citation must name one of that instance's listed outputs with the same attempt id and sha256, and a tool cannot be cited for more records than its result_record_count
a record may not cite a path that coverage.json lists as not analyzed or unsupported for the same tool
a path, rule id, resource address, repository or tag holding a run of 32 or more hex characters is refused by the schema: a hex digest is exempt from the redactor's entropy rule
a resource address or path that does not pass the redactor is published as null with a withheld disposition; the record is kept
a base-image reference is split into repository, tag and digest and carries them only in literal form; a tag is a mutable declaration and no registry is contacted

outputs/redaction-receipt.json is required and must verify with evidence_redaction.verify_receipt against the outputs/ directory under the policy and limits the consumer demands; it must list every other outputs/ contract file as published, and the bytes validated must hash to the receipt's published_sha256
every published JSON document must be a fixed point of the redactor: re-running it finds nothing to redact

outputs/applicability-probe-receipt.json is always required and must satisfy applicability-probe-receipt.schema.json; tool-results.json, coverage.json and the probe receipt must satisfy tool_instance_shapes.validate_node_aggregate
SKIPPED is permitted only with skip reason not-applicable-no-matching-inputs, a probe receipt showing zero matching inputs for every declared tool, no rule hits and no base images

run_id, job_id, attempt_id and source_snapshot_sha256 must agree across both result documents, tool-results.json, coverage.json, the probe receipt and status.json; each redactor block must equal the receipt's
scan-coverage-gap is asserted only by coverage.json
an empty result is not evidence of absence; a tool that cannot run offline is a BLOCKED tool instance and a named coverage gap, never a network exception
the result cannot promote a lead to a finding, a severity, or an observed runtime state
latest failed attempt blocks older accepted output
status.json carries only the required_status_fields plus the known runtime identifiers dagster_run_id and job_id; any other key is rejected and no value from it is ever reported
manifest.json is {schema appsec-review/attempt-manifest/1, contract_id, outputs[{path, sha256}]} naming exactly the files beneath outputs/ with the sha256 of their bytes
